name: TEMPLE_VEIL
canonical: the great heavy temple curtain before the Holy of Holies — thick woven linen of blue, purple and scarlet with cherubim figured into it, hanging full from ceiling to floor, massive and sealing. The barrier veil of the sanctuary — NOT a thin household drape, NOT a modern theatre curtain; shown whole and intact (its tearing is a separate moment)
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
